Rameshwaram’s Ramanathaswamy Temple is one of 12 Jyotirlingas, where Lord Rama worshipped Shiva after defeating Ravana. Sita crafted this Shivlingam from sand.
Built from the 12th century, with major contributions from Sri Lankan kings and later, the Sethupati dynasty of present Tamilnadu, especially for its iconic corridors.
The temple boasts the glorious temple corridor (Chokkattan Mandapam) with 1200 pillars, showcasing distinct Dravidian architecture.
